payload.credit_html: "New insights into the phylogenetic position and palaeobiogeography of Konkasaurus mahalana (Squamata: Scincoidea) from the Late Cretaceous of Madagascar"
payload.description_html: Figure S2. Standardized views of the postcranial axial skeleton of Konkasaurus mahalana. A) Proximal caudal vertebra, from top to bottom: rostral, dorsal, caudal, and ventral views. B) partial presacral vertebra, from left to right: dorsal, rostral, and ventral views. C–F) Distal caudal vertebrae, from left to right in C and D: left lateral, rostral, and right lateral views. G and H) ribs. Abbreviations: aut.sept = autotomy septum, con = vertebral condyle, Cot = vertebral cotyle, nca = neural canal, ncr = neural crest, par = parapophysis, prezyg= prezygapophysis, pozyg = postzygapophysis, tp = transverse process.
